h1: Run Autonomous AI Agents Across Ireland 24/7
sub: Give your business dedicated AI specialists equipped with isolated cloud computers, web automation, coding environments, and 1,000+ software integrations.
audience: Software engineers in Dublin's Silicon Docks, IFSC compliance leads, Cork biotechnology teams, Galway medtech researchers, and fast-moving Irish SMEs.
manifesto: Irish enterprise thrives on global agility and deep focus. Ceyo supplies persistent autonomous agents running on independent cloud computers around the clock, handling complex research, browser execution, and code while you step away from the screen.

uses.d: Your coding agent writes, runs, and tests backend scripts in an isolated cloud environment, pushing bug fixes and updates directly.
Bots monitor regulatory portals, compile structured sector summaries, and output detailed reports directly into your shared team documents.
An autonomous browser navigates international supplier websites, extracts updated freight pricing, and fills automated procurement logs.
Scheduled routines crawl global registries weekly, flagging relevant bio-engineering filings and notifying product leads via Slack.
Connect over 1,000 apps including Google Sheets and Notion to aggregate weekly performance metrics automatically without manual export.
Bots handle supplier inquiries through voice and phone-agent workflows, logging transport milestones in real time even while your phone is off.

steps.d: Launch a specialist in seconds with an isolated 24/7 cloud computer ready to execute tasks.
Link Telegram, Gmail, Slack, and your preferred cloud services from a library of 1,000+ apps.
Assign coding sprints, autonomous web browsing, or scheduled daily briefings to run continuously.

chapters.t: Morning brief at Grand Canal Dock
chapters.d: Before you step onto the Dart, your Telegram team bot has compiled overnight market changes and scheduled today's calendar priorities. Long memory ensures every action connects seamlessly with yesterday's strategy.

While you meet clients on Grafton Street, your bot navigates multiple supplier portals, inputs order specifications, and validates current pricing. It operates completely independently on its dedicated cloud computer.

Your technical agent writes, executes, and debugs automated deployment scripts within its secure sandbox environment. It integrates directly with GitHub and sends verified outputs to your development channel.
Even after your laptop closes and your phone goes offline, scheduled scrapers and document aggregators keep running. Any critical alerts route directly to voice or chat channels based on your rules.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial in Ireland?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; a payment card is linked at signup and is only billed when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Which languages can my Ceyo agents understand and write?
faq.a: Ceyo bots communicate fluently in English, Irish (Gaeilge), and dozens of global languages. They handle multilingual document analysis, translation, and localized correspondence effortlessly.

faq.q: How does the isolated cloud computer work when my device is off?
faq.a: Every bot runs on its own virtual cloud machine hosted in secure data centers. It executes continuous workflows, browses websites, and runs code 24/7 regardless of whether your computer or mobile phone is connected.

faq.q: Can I manage and coordinate bots directly through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, you can interact with your bots individually on Telegram or assemble multiple specialist bots inside Telegram group chats, where they coordinate tasks collaboratively as a unified team.

faq.q: What apps and integrations are supported out of the box?
faq.a: Ceyo connects with over 1,000 apps, including Gmail, Slack, Notion, Google Sheets, CRMs, and developer tools, alongside built-in crypto wallet functionality and voice call agents.
